approach:
I loaded the requirement-steps procedure for REQ-01. I read the five contracted inputs (roadmap, regulatory sources, connector inventory, model dependency map, decision log), the ticket (record:intake) and its GitHub source file, requirements/ZD-48600.md. I also read the earlier REQ-01 attempt's evaluation: its only automated failures were citations to related requirement files that it never read. So this time I read ZD-48211, ZD-48501 and ZD-48455 before citing them.

Neither the Pre Backlog sheet nor the DevOps board was in context. Instead I searched the requirements/ intake files and the trace ledger for duplicates. I found three related open items but no duplicate.

I split the ticket word for word into CR-0 to CR-7 and linked the entry to roadmap item R-AP-12. I checked it against decisions D-2026-031, D-2026-044 and D-2026-050 and lessons L-007 and L-011, and found no conflict. I ran the regulatory, connector and model-dependency checks against the inputs. The connector inventory covers only the ap_aging library, not the vendor feed change, so I raised that gap as an open question. Gaps are recorded as labelled assumptions (A-1 to A-6) and non-blocking open questions (Q-1 to Q-5). Shell use is denied in this step, so I used only Read, Glob, Grep and Write.
automated_failures: G1 judge found an unsupported statement: "Title | Overdue invoices ranked by vendor late-payment risk (feed -> delays -> risk -> overdue list -> portal table)" (The title is cited to record:intake, but the ticket does not rank by risk. overdue_with_risk sorts 'by days descending then id', and risk is only a label attach)

G1 judge found an unsupported statement: "Next step | REQ-02 Grouping (classification, duplicate merge)" (This is cited to record:brief, but the brief never mentions REQ-02, Grouping, classification or duplicate merge. The same unsourced step name comes back in 'Rel)

G1 judge found an unsupported statement: "No rule is changed or new, so CMP-P01 is not triggered." (No input, the brief or the trigger mentions CMP-P01. The step ID is invented, and the cited source (org.regulatory_sources) only says 'No regulatory source appl)

G1 judge found an unsupported statement: "The Requirement agent does not approve or prioritize backlog items." (No cited input or the brief states this. The brief only says the gate (PM) approves the output. Nothing in the sources mentions prioritization.)

G1 judge found an unsupported statement: "This agent cannot send notifications in this step." (This is cited to record:brief. The brief lists only api:github as an approved connector, but it also offers capability_request for missing capabilities. 'Cannot)

unsupported.why: This is cited to record:brief, but the brief never mentions REQ-02, Grouping, classification or duplicate merge. The same unsourced step name comes back in 'Related items (not duplicates; for REQ-02 Grouping)' and in Q-1 ('REQ-02 decides any merge').

unsupported.why: No cited input or the brief states this. The brief only says the gate (PM) approves the output. Nothing in the sources mentions prioritization.

unsupported.why: This is cited to record:brief. The brief lists only api:github as an approved connector, but it also offers capability_request for missing capabilities. 'Cannot' is stated as a fact when it is really an inference, and the agent made no capability_request (capability_requests: []).

judge.notes:
I read both outputs, all five REQ-01 inputs, requirements/ZD-48600.md, ZD-48211.md, ZD-48501.md, ZD-48455.md, REQ-01_attempt1.json and org.trace_ledger.md.

What holds up:
- feat.intake copies the ticket text word for word. It matches both record:intake and requirements/ZD-48600.md, and the channel, source, received date (2026-10-24) and repos all match.
- CR-0 to CR-7 follow the ticket's own wording without adding anything.
- The summaries of the org overrides (data model, customer mappings, architecture, risk map) match the frontmatter of ZD-48600.md.
- The prebacklog links correctly to R-AP-12 (Q4 2026, AP module, owner PM) and correctly leaves out R-AP-14 (export).
- The regulatory, connector and model-dependency checks quote their inputs accurately. Q-2 correctly points out that the connector inventory covers only the ap_aging library and says nothing about the vendor feed v3 change.
- The decision check against D-2026-031, D-2026-044 and D-2026-050, and the lessons L-007 and L-011 (from memory/MEMORY.md), is accurate and finds no conflicts.
- The three related items (ZD-48501, ZD-48211, ZD-48455) are all status 'open' and are described accurately: the same >30-day overdue rule; row-overdue in the aging-summary table versus overdue-risk.
- A-1 to A-6 and Q-1 to Q-5 are clearly labelled as assumptions or questions and invent no facts.

Problems:
- The title says items are 'ranked by risk', which gets the sort order wrong.
- 'REQ-02 Grouping' and 'CMP-P01' are step names that appear in no source.

Completeness against the workbook outcome:
- An entry was created and linked to the roadmap item.
- No notification was sent. The output says so openly (Q-3), but no capability_request was made.
- The Pre Backlog sheet and DevOps board check was swapped for a search of requirements/. This is disclosed (Q-1).

Tool-view note: the attempt JSON records automated G2 failures saying ZD-48211, ZD-48501 and ZD-48455 were never read in the session. The brief lists them as files the agent read, and the output's statements about them match their content, so I did not count them as ungrounded.
